orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To construct a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities, we will allocate investments across each year to ensure a consistent cash flow and to mitigate interest rate risk. The proposed allocation will distribute the investments evenly across the 1 to 5-year maturity buckets, with each bucket receiving 20% of the portfolio. This structure adheres to the laddered maturity requirement and ensures no more than 30% of the portfolio matures in any single year. The portfolio will consist of bonds from developed regions with credit ratings of BBB+ or higher to meet the investment-grade requirement. The proposed portfolio has an average duration of approximately 3 years, well below the 7-year warning threshold and the 10-year maximum duration limit.
